title: How to Lower Blood Sugar Fast
description: How do you lower your blood sugar fast?   Blood sugar regulation is one of the most important functions in the body to stay healthy and prevent disease...  Dr. Aron Choi practices in Seattle, Washington. He helps his patients and clients restore their health and stay healthy by uncovering the root cause of their disease and teaching skills to perform at their best.   Website: https://www.aronchoi.com Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/draronchoi Medium: https://medium.com/@aronchoi/ Podcast: https://radiopublic.com/the-awkward-silence-podcast-WDJKpp

asr.full_text: How do you lower your blood sugar fast? Blood sugar regulation is one of the most important functions of your body, and it's one of the most important ingredients in staying healthy, prevening chronic diseases like diabetes, heart disease, cancers, and you don't wanna get to a point where you need to inject insulin or take a medication to lower your blood sugar. So I'm gonna give you three different ways to lower your blood sugar fast without taking any more pills, without taking any medication or doing anything too extreme so first, blood sugar where does it come from and why do we need to manage it. Every time we eat food, especially carbohydrates, but even proteins, we break down that food into their little components that we can use as energy. We absorb it and we convert it to blood glucose. This is the the currency of Energy One of the currencies of energy that we have in our bloodstream to then turn that into energy. So we need some blood glucose in our bloodstream. So where the problems can happen? Why does blood sugar get higher? Well, blood sugar gets high if you are insulin resistant. So insulin is a hormone. It signals your body, your cells, to take that blood glucose out of your bloodstream and take it to the cells where it needs. Like your muscles, your eyes, whatever you know whatever it might be every most tissues need glucose to make energy and what can happen over time whether it's due to stress or you know not living the right lifestyle, eating too much sugar, well insulin doesn't work as efficiently, your body stops responding to insulin and there's a reason why if your blood sugar is constantly high and it just let all that blood glucose enter your cells it will destroy the cells it would cause damage so there's a reason why there's insulin resistance so we want to make sure we manage this blood glucose so we want it in a nice tight window. If you've ever checked your fasting blood glucose you want it between 70 and 90. You don't want it to low. You don't want it too high and you want to keep that window nice and tight. So then pre-diabetes, people who have blood sugar levels above 100 constantly. If you are diabetic, you might have seen 200, 300, 400. The higher that goes, your fasting blood glucose, that can start resulting in different issues. When you have diabetes, it can damage your kidneys. It can damage your nerves and your feet. And that's when we get diabetic neuropathy. So there are a lot of issues with high blood glucose. Now, how do we lower that blood sugar fast? Is one of the first line therapies for high blood sugar is exercise and movement, and don't be afraid of that word exercise, and I'm not talking about running a marathon. I'm not talking about going to do CrossFit, doing some extreme athletic event that you are not prepared to do. Movement can include taking a walk, going up and down stairs. So one of my aunts was diagnosed with diabetes. And well before I became a doctor, she started a habit of after eating, she would, you know, do a gentle walk on a treadmill, and she would walk until her blood sugar got into a safe range the range where she wanted to. So something as simple as walking, 20 minutes, 30 minutes, and if you do have a blood glucose meter you can check the changes in your blood sugars before and after exercise and you will see the effect. Once you see the cause of the effect, you'll see how important movement is to lowering your blood sugar. So whether you are, you know, you're starting from couch to, or whether you are, you know, maybe working out once a week, and maybe it's kind of rare and it'd be far between those workouts, try walking twenty minutes a day before you eat, after you eat, and see what happens to your blood sugar. The second thing that you can do to start lowering your blood sugar fast is adding a little bit of fiber into your meals. If you're used to eating something like white bread, crackers, and chips, one of the fastest ways to prevent a rise in blood sugar is to add some fiber with your meals. So whether that's some celery over some broccoli, there's a reason why vegetables and fruits have benefits to improving blood sugar because when you have some fiber with the meal it slows the absorption of blood glucose and slows the rise of blood sugar after a meal. So add a little fiber into your into your meals. And just kind of pay attention. What are you eating, can you just add a little bit of good stuff. You don't have to change everything over night. But, add a little bit of fiber. Add a vegetable. Something like celery with almond butter, right. That's one of my favorite snacks these days. And you will feel full longer, and it will prevent some of those cravings. The third way to lower blood sugar fast. And this is going to sound a little counterintuitive, but this single act is a way to control cravings, it's a way to lower stress, it is a way to give your body a change to heal, and that is sleep. So some of the highest rates of chronic disease, diabetes, heart disease, cancer, were found in one of the biggest studies looking at nurses and healthcare workers who work overnight. They work a swing shift. They work the swing shift, they work the graveyard shift, and not getting enough sleep at the right times will decrease your insulin sensitivity, raise your cortisol levels, throw off your circadian rhythm. The hormones cycle with the day and night cycle. So a lot of people who don't get enough sleep regularly are more prone to high blood sugar and diabetes. So whether that is because you know, your own doing, you're working late, you got a lot going on or whether your job mandates that you have to work overnight, work the graveyard shift. Just know that there's a trade-off to doing these things. And when it comes to your health, you know, what's more important, your health or your job, right? I know it's not always easy, but you have to then consider what price are you paying for having that type of lifestyle and what type of lifestyle do you need to keep your blood sugar in check and I'll give you a bonus one number four so you may have heard that intermittent you know heard about intermittent fasting or time-restricted feeding and what this really means is giving yourself a period of time regularly where you're NOT eating. So some of the WORST advice that I see with anyone with diabetes is to eat more frequent... Small meals throughout the day. But what happens when you're eating small meals throughout the day? You're getting this blood glucose spike every few hours and I understand maybe the logic that went into that, so if you're eating a big meal, your blood sugar goes up really high, so why not spread it out? But this doesn't take into consideration what someone is eating. Your blood sugar won't go as high if you're having a little bit fiber, if you're having low-glycemic index foods — foods that won't raise your blood sugar. The body wasn't designed to be constantly digesting. It takes a lot of energy to digest food and your body needs a period of time process and to heal. So a simple way to implement intermittent fasting or time-restricted feeding is to close the window when you're actually eating. So here's one way to put it, have 12 hours between the last bite of food that you eat and the first bite of food you have in the morning. So that, means if you finish eating at 7 p.m., the next meal you want to have at the earliest is 7 a.m. And you can even widen that window a bit. So from 7 p.m., maybe you eat at 9 a.m. Then you start putting all these things together. Maybe you go for a walk before you have your first meal in the day. That first meal is not just hash browns. But you have hash browns and you have some vegetables with those hash browns. Make sure you get a good night's sleep before you start your day the next day and you will find that when you combine these tips together you will manage your blood sugar much more efficiently and it seems pretty simple but what this is is it's giving body the right conditions it needs to lower blood sugar fast, right? The symptoms that we experience are messages from our body that something is not right. And we need to correct those conditions in order to be healthy. And in this case, manage your blood sugar. So like this video if this case, manage your blood sugar. So like this video, if this was helpful. Drop a comment what was surprising for you. Subscribe if you want to see more videos like this and I will see you in the next one.
